name: Laila Na
source:
Laila is [url=/c148353]Yuna[/url]’s mother, and a key reason why [url=/c148291]MC[/url] and [url=/c148296]Laura[/url] were able to avoid the worst case scenarios. A key figure in MC’s teen life. She tries to save the world despite complications of her own.
